_readme:
User-facing strings for the next release. The release pipeline stamps versionName/versionCode, merges entries into app/src/main/assets/changelog.json, then resets entries to [].
If you don't see your entry, it means that it's been already released.
entries: In-app changelog: view What's New after updates and full history from Help & Info.
You can now see points of interest near your location! Check it out in the Menu->Places.
We've done a big menu refactor to make things easier to find, and easier to manage with gloves on.
